roleArn.description: IAM role ARN for the SIG controller ServiceAccount (inference-gateway-controller). Wired via IRSA — annotated onto the SA at helm render time (matches the ALB Controller and KEDA pattern). Used by the auto-issue TLS flow to call acm:ImportCertificate. Provision the role out of band (the SageMakerInferenceGateway repo ships docs/scripts/create-cert-issuer-role.sh; production customers get it from Quick Setup CFN). Empty → auto-issue disabled; the controller still supports HTTP-only and bring-your-own-ARN modes.
